meta.title: An auction's end includes automatic extensions; an RFQ's end does not
gaps: The available vocabulary cannot configure an auction's automatic-extension schedule of two minutes during the last two minutes.
read_round has no extension-count field, so the change from 0 to 1 cannot be verified.
No token exposes the original round end plus 120 seconds, so the exact new end time cannot be asserted.
The same plan cannot compare the auction schedule with an RFQ end without a separate fresh RFQ scenario.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).

As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked); Data check: “rfx mode” equals auction; Schema check: “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked); Data check: “rfx mode” equals auction; Schema check: “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
